info.name: Telemetron External API (ext-v1) Customer Device API

description.content:
RESTful API for syncing customer, device, and ownership-mapping data into Telemetron so it can correlate device telemetry with customers for AI-powered hardware support. Faithfully modeled from the published Telemetron API reference at https://docs.telemetron.ai/api-reference — every path, parameter, and response field below is transcribed from the docs; no fields were invented.
